The '''glass man''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Appearance==
Seemingly made of glass, the man is about a foot tall and has its hand raised as if to signal stop.

==Use==
The ''ter'angreal'' was made to chase away vermin, such as rats and mice. It is unknown if channeling is needed to make it work.{{ref/book|11|15}}
